pitch:
Methea is a research-methods navigator for Master's and PhD students. You describe your topic or upload your assignment brief.
It asks focused questions to sharpen your research question, suggests theories from a curated library and explains why each fits, and builds a framework diagram.
It never writes text you would submit: no essay paragraphs, no discussion, no conclusion.
Free: topic, research question, theory suggestions and the framework diagram.
$49 per project, one-time: full framework with verified citations, methodology chain, interview guide mapped to your framework, transcript analysis, full export. 6 months of access, no subscription.
14-day money-back guarantee. Online, works in the browser.
